maddeler.e:
اكتنزوا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَنَزُوا (iktanazū) /ik.ta.na.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# اُكْتُنِزُوا (uktunizū) /uk.tu.ni.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# اِكْتَنِزُوا (iktanizū) /ik.ta.ni.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
